title: finding(plugin-detail): RelatedList's row fetch sends no `$select`, so a denied column is returned over the wire and dropped only at the column layer — the surface has objectui#6898's expand half and has never had the select half
body:
Ruled: 5814461689 · letter select (FLS-projected $select on RelatedList) · 2026-09-24T12:51Z

## The finding

`RelatedList`'s row fetch sends **no `$select` at all**, so a field the current principal cannot read is returned over the wire and dropped only afterwards, when `effectiveColumns` applies `filterFLS` to the **columns**. FLS is applied nowhere on the request.

Evidence: the auto-fetch params object is built with `$filter`, `$top`, `$skip`, `$orderby` — and, after objectui#10185, `$expand` — and no projection.

**Named failing probe**: render `RelatedList` under a permissions provider that denies one column, and assert `dataSource.find` is called with a `$select` excluding it. Red today.

## ⭐ Honest grading, because it changes what this is

`DetailView`'s own comment records that ObjectStack's server masks denied fields (`FieldMasker.maskRecord`). ⇒ against **that** backend this is a **defence-in-depth gap, ⛔ not a live disclosure**. It is load-bearing for a backend that does not strip — which is exactly the ground the sibling gates were graded on.

⛔ This card does **not** claim data is leaking today. It claims the client asks for more than it may read and relies on the server to be careful.

## Why it is the same class the repo has already ruled twice

objectui#6898 ruled the `$select` projection for `ListView`; objectui#7215 / #7230 extended it to `$expand` roots. ⇒ **this surface now has the expand half and has never had the select half.** The asymmetry is the finding.

## ⚠️ It needs a ruling before it needs a fix

⛔ Deliberately not repaired alongside objectui#10112: a related list derives its **columns from rows it has not fetched yet**, so narrowing the projection is not the same operation it is on `ListView`. Whether a related list may narrow at all — and what it does on the first fetch, before any column is known — is a design question, ⛔ not a mechanical port of the sibling gates.

## Provenance and radius

Measured by the dev on objectui#10112 while adding the `$expand` half, ⛔ not re-derived by this seat beyond confirming the params object carries no projection. Radius: `RelatedList`'s auto-fetch path. ⛔ Outside: the caller-supplied-data path, and every other surface in the family — the sibling gates suggest most are covered, but that was not measured here.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat #1 (`session_01Xr7APep6jm1Zta3KUzPzZf`) at ACCEPT. ⛔ Filed bare.
